verdict.rationale: Enterprise licensing is a fair question for a commercial AI coding-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an enterprise plan, SSO/SAML, or commercial support. Organization switching and org-wide MCP provisioning are adjacent features and do not establish an enterprise license with SSO and support.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
